description: Defines test classes for a QUIC client, including MockableQuicClient and QuicTestClient, with methods for sending requests, managing streams, and configuring client behavior.

classes.name: MockableQuicClient
classes.description: A mockable QUIC client for testing, allowing control over connection IDs, packets, and network helper.

classes.name: QuicTestClient
classes.description: A test utility client for sending requests, managing streams, and configuring client parameters for testing QUIC servers.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a simple GET request for a URI.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Wraps data in a QUIC packet and sends it.

methods.name: SetUserAgentID
methods.description: Sets the user agent ID for the client.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the client from the server.

methods.name: UseWriter
methods.description: Configures the client to use a specific packet writer.

methods.name: UseConnectionId
methods.description: Sets a specific server connection ID.

methods.name: UseClientConnectionId
methods.description: Sets a specific client connection ID.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStream
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a stream for communication.
